allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

tech_stack.description: Technology stack for the implementation, including languages, frameworks, infrastructure, and tools.

allOf.description: Inherits the structured technology stack definition from core collections.

tech_stack_ref.description: Canonical reference for the technology stack entry in the registry.

milestones.description: Ordered list of implementation milestones with deliverables and status tracking.

milestone_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this milestone.

target_date.description: Planned completion date for this milestone (ISO 8601 date).

status.description: Current progress status of the milestone.

risks.description: Known risks that could delay or block this milestone.

spikes.description: Technical spikes or investigations required before work can proceed.

deliverables.description: Trace references to artifacts this milestone will produce.

items.description: A trace reference to an artifact this milestone will produce.

depends_on.description: IDs of milestones that must complete before this milestone can begin.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the status value in the registry.

items.description: A single implementation milestone with deliverables, risks, and status tracking.

migration_plan.description: High-level strategy for migrating from existing systems or data to the new implementation.

dependencies.description: External or internal dependencies required by the implementation.

dependency_ref.description: Canonical reference for the dependency list in the registry.

environment_ref.description: Canonical reference for the target deployment environment.

trace.description: Traceability links connecting this plan to upstream and downstream artifacts.

items.description: A traceability reference for the implementation plan.
